linkedMainEntries.example: Many young people choose apprenticeships to gain practical skills.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 许多年轻人选择学徒制来获得实用技能。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指能够从一个地方、人或情况转移到另一个的。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Able to be moved from one place, person, or situation to another.
linkedMainEntries.example: This ticket is not transferable to another person.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 这张票不能转让给他人。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指被正式提议担任某职位或获得某奖项的。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Formally proposed for a position or award.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To formally suggest someone for a position or award.
otherMeanings.example: The committee nominated her for the role of chairperson.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 委员会提名她担任主席一职。

linkedMainEntries.example: The nominated candidate gave an impressive speech.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 被提名的候选人发表了令人印象深刻的演讲。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指在保险、遗嘱或退休金计划中，由投保人或账户持有人正式指定，在特定事件发生时（如死亡）有权获得保险金或资产的人。
linkedMainEntries.definition: A person who has been formally designated to receive benefits, such as insurance proceeds or assets, upon the occurrence of a specified event, typically the death of the policyholder or account holder.
linkedMainEntries.example: You should update your nominated beneficiary after major life changes such as marriage or divorce.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 在结婚或离婚等重大生活变化后，你应该更新你的指定受益人。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指可能发生但不确定的事件，通常需要提前准备或应对。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Possible but uncertain future events or conditions, especially ones that may cause problems and need to be prepared for.
linkedMainEntries.example: The project has a contingency fund to cover unexpected costs.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 该项目有一笔应急基金，用于支付意外费用。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 机械中用于将旋转运动转换为直线运动或改变运动方向的零件。
linkedMainEntries.definition: A part of a machine that changes rotary motion into linear motion or controls the movement of another part.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Informal short for camera or webcam.
otherMeanings.example: Turn on the cam for the video call.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 打开摄像头进行视频通话。

linkedMainEntries.example: The engine's cam controls the opening and closing of the valves.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 发动机的凸轮控制气门的开启和关闭。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 公开的集会或游行，以表达对某事的支持或抗议；也指展示或证明。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Public meetings or marches held to show support or protest; also acts of showing or proving something.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: An act of showing how something works or is done.
otherMeanings.example: The teacher gave a demonstration of the experiment.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 老师演示了实验。

linkedMainEntries.example: Thousands of people joined the demonstrations against the new law.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 数千人参加了反对新法律的示威游行。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指某个特定的方面或细节；也指表示敬意的行为。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Particular aspects or details; also acts of showing respect.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Third person singular of respect, meaning to admire or treat with consideration.
otherMeanings.example: She respects her elders.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她尊重长辈。

linkedMainEntries.example: In many respects, the new policy is an improvement.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 在许多方面，新政策是一个改进。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指某事物值得拥有、希望得到或令人向往的性质。
linkedMainEntries.definition: The quality of being worth having or wanting; the extent to which something is desirable.
linkedMainEntries.example: The desirability of the location made the apartment very expensive.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 该地段的可取性使得这套公寓非常昂贵。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 港口是供船只停靠、装卸货物和上下乘客的地方。
linkedMainEntries.definition: A harbor or place where ships dock to load and unload cargo or passengers.
linkedMainEntries.example: The ship will arrive at the port tomorrow morning.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 船将于明天早上抵达港口。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指原子或分子获得或失去电子形成离子的过程。
linkedMainEntries.definition: The process by which an atom or molecule acquires a positive or negative charge by gaining or losing electrons.
linkedMainEntries.example: Ionisation of the air occurs during a thunderstorm.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 雷暴期间空气会发生电离。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指双方彼此给予或接受，关系对等。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Given or felt by each toward the other; mutual.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A number that when multiplied by the original number gives 1.
otherMeanings.example: The reciprocal of 2 is 1/2.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 2的倒数是1/2。

linkedMainEntries.example: The two countries signed a reciprocal trade agreement.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 两国签署了一项互惠贸易协定。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指缺乏秩序或组织，可能涉及行为或环境。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Lacking order or organization; messy or unruly.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Involving a breach of public order.
otherMeanings.example: He was arrested for disorderly conduct.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他因妨害治安行为被捕。

linkedMainEntries.example: The disorderly queue caused confusion at the entrance.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 混乱的队伍在入口处造成了混乱。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指允许或忍受某事存在或发生，尽管可能不喜欢或反对。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Allowed or endured without protest or interference.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To be able to withstand a drug or treatment without adverse effects.
otherMeanings.example: The patient tolerated the chemotherapy well.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 病人对化疗耐受良好。

linkedMainEntries.example: The noise was tolerated by the neighbors for years.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 多年来邻居们一直容忍这种噪音。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指某事物的主要目的或设计初衷。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Mainly designed or meant for a particular purpose.
linkedMainEntries.example: The course is primarily intended for beginners.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 这门课程主要面向初学者。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指问题、情况或机会开始存在或发生。
linkedMainEntries.definition: To come into existence or become apparent.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To get up or move upward.
otherMeanings.example: He arises early every morning.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他每天早晨起得很早。

linkedMainEntries.example: Problems arise when communication breaks down.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 当沟通中断时，问题就会出现。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 由金属环连接而成的链子，用于固定或束缚。
linkedMainEntries.definition: A series of connected metal rings used for fastening or restraining.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A sequence of related things or events.
otherMeanings.example: The chain of events led to a major crisis.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 一系列事件导致了重大危机。

linkedMainEntries.example: The bicycle was secured with a heavy chain.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 自行车用一条粗链锁住了。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 金属环或锁链，用于锁住囚犯的手腕或脚踝，也比喻限制或束缚。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Metal rings or chains used to lock a prisoner's wrists or ankles; also a metaphor for restrictions.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To put shackles on someone; to restrict or limit.
otherMeanings.example: The new regulations shackle small businesses.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 新规定束缚了小企业。

linkedMainEntries.example: The prisoner was led away in shackles.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 囚犯戴着镣铐被带走了。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 一种用于提升和移动重物的机器，也指一种大型涉禽。
linkedMainEntries.definition: A machine for lifting and moving heavy objects, or a large wading bird.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To stretch out one's neck to see something.
otherMeanings.example: She craned her neck to see over the crowd.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她伸长脖子看人群那边。

linkedMainEntries.example: The construction site had several cranes lifting steel beams.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 建筑工地有几台起重机在吊起钢梁。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 严格遵守规则、协议或信念。
linkedMainEntries.definition: To stick firmly to a rule, agreement, or belief.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To stick to a surface.
otherMeanings.example: The stamp adhered to the envelope.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 邮票粘在信封上。

linkedMainEntries.example: All employees must adhere to the company's safety regulations.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 所有员工必须遵守公司的安全规定。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指刚学会走路、年龄约1至3岁的儿童。
linkedMainEntries.definition: young children who are just learning to walk, typically aged between one and three
linkedMainEntries.example: The playground is designed for toddlers and young children.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 这个游乐场是为幼儿和年幼儿童设计的。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指在绩效评估或评价过程中给出的正式意见或评论。
linkedMainEntries.definition: a formal statement or remark given during an appraisal, typically about performance
linkedMainEntries.example: The manager wrote a positive appraisal comment on her annual review.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 经理在她的年度评估中写下了积极的评价意见。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 用于记录每日事件、想法或感受的书籍或电子记录。
linkedMainEntries.definition: books or records in which people write about their daily experiences, thoughts, or feelings

otherMeanings.definitionEn: a book with spaces for each day of the year, used for recording appointments or plans
otherMeanings.example: She checked her diary to see if she was free on Friday.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她查看日程本，看周五是否有空。

linkedMainEntries.example: She kept detailed diaries during her travels, which later became the basis for her memoir.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 她在旅行期间写了详细的日记，这些日记后来成为她回忆录的基础。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 被选派或委派代表他人或组织参加会议、集会等的人。
linkedMainEntries.definition: people who are chosen or elected to represent others, especially at a meeting or conference

otherMeanings.definitionEn: to give part of your work, power, or authority to someone else
otherMeanings.example: The manager delegated the task of organizing the event to her assistant.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 经理把组织活动的任务委派给了她的助手。

linkedMainEntries.example: The conference was attended by delegates from over fifty countries.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 来自五十多个国家的代表出席了会议。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指没有其他人陪同或陪伴的，尤其指儿童或旅行者。
linkedMainEntries.definition: not accompanied by someone; alone

otherMeanings.definitionEn: performed without instrumental accompaniment
otherMeanings.example: The choir sang an unaccompanied hymn.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 合唱团演唱了一首无伴奏的赞美诗。

linkedMainEntries.example: Unaccompanied minors are not allowed to board the flight without parental consent.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 无人陪伴的未成年人在没有父母同意的情况下不得登机。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 表示属于某个大陆或洲的，例如“非洲大陆的”。
linkedMainEntries.definition: belonging to or relating to a continent
linkedMainEntries.example: The continent's economy has grown rapidly in recent years.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 该大陆的经济近年来增长迅速。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 通过雕刻、塑造或铸造材料（如石头、金属或木头）制成的三维艺术品。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Three-dimensional works of art made by carving, modeling, or casting materials such as stone, metal, or wood.
linkedMainEntries.example: The park is famous for its modern sculptures by local artists.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 这个公园以当地艺术家的现代雕塑而闻名。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 极高的，通常指建筑物或山脉等，给人留下深刻印象。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Extremely tall, especially in a way that is impressive.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Very great or impressive in quality or importance.
otherMeanings.example: She is a towering figure in the field of science.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她是科学领域的一位杰出人物。

linkedMainEntries.example: The towering skyscrapers dominate the city skyline.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 高耸的摩天大楼主宰着城市的天际线。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 公开展示某物，尤其是艺术品或物品，供人们观看。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Shown publicly, especially works of art or objects, for people to see.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Showed a particular quality or feeling.
otherMeanings.example: He exhibited great courage during the crisis.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他在危机中表现出极大的勇气。

linkedMainEntries.example: Her paintings were exhibited at the national gallery last month.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 她的画作上个月在国家美术馆展出。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 使用少量词语表达，简明扼要。
linkedMainEntries.definition: The quality of using few words; conciseness.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: The quality of lasting a short time.
otherMeanings.example: The brevity of the meeting surprised everyone.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 会议的短暂让所有人感到惊讶。

linkedMainEntries.example: The brevity of the speech made it more impactful.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 演讲的简洁使其更有影响力。

phraseCollocations.phrase: brevity is the soul of wit
phraseCollocations.chinese: 言简意赅是智慧的灵魂

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指某事的原因或来源可以追溯到某事物。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Able to be attributed to a particular cause or source.
linkedMainEntries.example: The increase in sales is attributable to the new marketing strategy.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 销售额的增长归因于新的营销策略。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 非常小的液体滴，尤其指空气中传播的飞沫。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Plural of droplet; very small drops of liquid.
linkedMainEntries.example: The virus spreads through respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 病毒通过感染者咳嗽时的呼吸道飞沫传播。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指疾病、信息或信号等被从一个地方或人传递到另一个地方或人。
linkedMainEntries.definition: passed from one person, place, or thing to another

otherMeanings.definitionEn: past tense and past participle of transmit; to send or pass something from one place to another
otherMeanings.example: The radio station transmitted the signal over a wide area.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 广播电台将信号传送到广阔的区域。

linkedMainEntries.example: The disease is transmitted through close contact with infected individuals.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 这种疾病通过与感染者的密切接触传播。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: rise的过去分词，表示从较低位置向上移动或数量、水平等增加。
linkedMainEntries.definition: past participle of rise; to move upwards or increase in amount or level
linkedMainEntries.example: The cost of living has risen sharply over the past decade.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 过去十年生活成本急剧上升。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 指通过宣传、支持或采取行动来推动某事的发展或增加其影响力。
linkedMainEntries.definition: The act of supporting or actively encouraging a cause, product, or idea.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: The act of raising someone to a higher rank or position.
otherMeanings.example: Her promotion to manager was announced last week.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她晋升为经理的消息上周宣布了。

linkedMainEntries.example: The government is promoting the use of renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 政府正在推广使用可再生能源以减少碳排放。

linkedMainEntries.meaningDetailZh: 形容事物能够吸引人的注意力或兴趣，令人投入。
linkedMainEntries.definition: Charming and attractive; able to capture and hold interest.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: The act of taking part in something or being involved in an activity.
otherMeanings.example: Engaging in regular exercise improves health.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 定期锻炼有助于改善健康。

linkedMainEntries.example: The teacher used engaging activities to make the lesson more interesting.
linkedMainEntries.exampleCn: 老师使用有趣的活动使课程更加生动。
